items.text: I was curious about this game for years before I got to play it.  I'm always interested in experiments in interactive narrative, and this is certainly an experiment.  Unfortunately, the results of the experiment are not very interesting and come off as somewhat problematic in its views of women, without any sort of self-reflection on that.
items.text_zh: 在我玩到这款游戏之前，我已经对它好奇了好几年。我一直对互动叙事的实验很感兴趣，而这无疑是一次实验。遗憾的是，实验的结果并不怎么有趣，而且在对女性的看法上显得有些问题，却对此没有任何自我反思。

observations.description: 叙事对女性观点有问题且缺乏自我反思
